applicabilityBasis.summary: OUSG represents tokenized limited partnership interests in Ondo I LP, a Delaware private investment fund with a managed Treasury-fund portfolio and variable net asset value. Issuer disclosures restrict access to accredited investors and qualified purchasers; Connecticut DOB records a Rule 506(c) offering. The fund interest, rather than investor eligibility alone, supports the GENIUS security exclusion.

genius.licensingRegulator: SEC Reg D / qualified purchaser context
genius.notes: OUSG is treated as outside GENIUS payment-stablecoin tracking because Ondo presents it as a qualified-access tokenized Treasury fund product. On December 9, 2025, Ondo announced that its confidential, multi-year SEC investigation had closed without charges; the announcement does not establish the exact closure date. Connecticut DOB Bulletin 3225 separately records a December 12, 2025 stipulation with Ondo I LP and its adviser over delinquent securities notice filings, now cured, with a $500 fine for the fund and $1,000 for the adviser. The warning-or-notice field records this historical securities action, not GENIUS enforcement or a fund issuance prohibition. The official bulletin was recovered from its May 19, 2026 Wayback snapshot and independently reopened on 2026-10-07. Public subscriptions and redemptions occur at variable NAV; redemptionPolicyPresent remains false for a fixed 1:1 payment-stablecoin policy. Daily NAV reporting and annual fund audit do not establish monthly payment-stablecoin reserve attestations.
